caseNameFull: In the Matter of Joseph Rubinstein and In the Matter of Charles Rubinstein
attorneys: Mr. Brien McMahon for petitioners. Mr. Charles Auer-bach for respondents.

opinions.text:
The motion to dispense with printing portions of the record is granted. The petition for writs of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Ohio is denied.

Reported below: 136 Ohio St. 341; 25 N. E. 2d 680.-
